intro.title: Our Cookie Policy
intro.description: At DEEPROOTS, we believe in privacy by design — not intrusive tracking. We use cookies sparingly, only where they improve your experience or help us protect the platform.

uses.title: What We Use Cookies For
uses.preference: Remember your preferences (like dark mode or language)
uses.session: Secure your session if you log in

donts.title: What We Never Do
donts.noDataResale: No data resale or behavioral tracking
donts.noAdsOrProfiling: No personalized ads or invasive profiling

control.title: Your Control
control.subtitle: You can manage cookies in these ways:
control.clearOrBlock: Clear or block cookies via browser settings
control.useRequiredOnly: Use site with only required cookies
